messages:
Nina (People Ops): Quick ping 1 - HR published an updated goal-setting & performance calibration section in the handbook. We're also rolling out a mandatory 25-min unconscious-bias microtraining for all people managers. Need manager ack + team enrolment by next Wed. :clipboard:
Maya (Eng Manager): Thanks Nina. Is the manager training separate from the general employee one?
Nina (People Ops): Yes 1 - managers have a manager-specific module with a short facilitation guide. ICs get the standard 15-min version. Links on the hub: https://hub.example.com/hr/performance-2026 (internal).
Carlos (HRBP): Important: calibration window closes two weeks after ack deadline, so please schedule calibration meetings ASAP. We'll publish the calibration rubric in the shared drive.
Omar (Talent): Will new hires be included in this cycle? I'm onboarding two EMs next week.
Nina (People Ops): New hires on the books before the ack deadline are included. For hires after the deadline we'll include them in the next cycle. Put new hire rows in the CSV with "start_date" column.
Maya (Eng Manager): Can you paste the CSV header so I can bulk add my org?
Nina (People Ops): Header: manager_email,employee_email,role,team,start_date,preferred_session,manager_ack
Nina (People Ops): ```manager_email,employee_email,role,team,start_date,preferred_session,manager_ack```
Maya (Eng Manager): For preferred_session, do we use slot ids? My team is EMEA heavy.
Nina (People Ops): Use S1 (08:00 PT), S2 (12:00 PT), S3 (18:00 PT). We'll map to local timezones when we import.
Omar (Talent): Quick Q: if a manager refuses the training for religious reasons, what's the accommodation process?
Carlos (HRBP): Escalate to People Ops + Legal via case ticket. We'll track accomodations in the tracker and provide an alternate compliance route.
Maya (Eng Manager): If someone can't attend live, is the worksheet + quiz acceptable?
Nina (People Ops): Yes for most roles. For calibration leads we require live attendance or recorded debrief with HR.
remind-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Performance policy ack + manager training" will post at T-72h and T-24h before deadline.
Maya (Eng Manager): Uploaded CSV and marked 3 folks as ON_LEAVE in start_date comment.
Nina (People Ops): Thanks. Managers: checklist before deadline - 1) bulk upload CSV, 2) ensure manager_ack column is set to TRUE, 3) confirm team members enrolled in their preferred sessions. I'll export completion stats after the window: ```gsutil cp gs://redwood-ops/hr/perf_cycle_2026.csv ./perf_cycle_2026.csv```
Omar (Talent): I'll sync with recruiting to flag anyone starting during the cycle.
Carlos (HRBP): If any policy questions come up, label threads with "policy-question" and I'll triage with Legal.
Maya (Eng Manager): Appreciate the heads up. I'll run calibration blocks next week.
Nina (People Ops): Final note: sending a short manager facilitation kit and a paste-ready Slack reminder in 10m. :sparkles:
